kind: source/page split and custody proposal; metadata only; NOT gold answers
not_a_manifest: This file is a source-selection proposal, not qa02.manifest.v1. Selected cases become a qa02.manifest.v1 only through a separate reviewed PR169 reference freeze. Do not consume this JSON as a manifest.
not_gold: No reference answers, expected dish counts, labels, transcriptions or predictions are contained here. Source-only human annotation, independent review and freeze are separate gates.

routes.shared_constraints: Hosted routes require an authenticated actor, an authorized venue and a deployed queue. Upload groups accept one PDF or 1-5 JPEG/PNG images, each file at most 12,000,000 bytes, and a PDF must parse at 1-10 pages; the server verifies actual bytes, signature and hash. URL intake requires a public destination, at most 12 MB for non-HTML, at most 3 redirects, and an HTML page that resolves exactly one linked PDF/PNG/JPEG. None of these routes was executed here.

steps: Preflight custody SHA-256 equals the declared hash; size is at most 12,000,000 bytes; page count is within 1-10.
Create the upload group for one PDF with the declared source hash and a unique idempotency key.
Upload the original PDF bytes with application/pdf and the same idempotency key.
Verify the job source_hash equals the declared hash and source_uploaded is true before extraction.
candidate_A_pdf_upload.substitution_rule: This route legitimately uses the original local file; it must not be described as URL intake.

steps: Fresh GET of the official href; body SHA-256 must equal the declared hash immediately before the request.
Create the URL intake with the official href and a unique idempotency key; the server re-downloads it.
Verify the job source_hash equals the declared hash and the recorded finalUrl equals the official href.
Any hash or URL drift means STOP, re-version the candidate and request renewed approval; do not score.
candidate_B_url_intake.substitution_rule: Must be a genuine server-side URL fetch with retained provenance; uploading the downloaded local file and calling it URL intake is prohibited.
